title: cli: unreadable source files are silently ignored

# Bug: Unreadable Source Files Silently Ignored

## Severity
P1 - MAJOR

## Description
When source files are not readable (permission denied), the index command silently skips them with no warning. The user may not realize that files were not processed.

## Reproduction Steps
1. mkdir /tmp/perm-test
2. echo "# Test" > /tmp/perm-test/test.md
3. chmod 000 /tmp/perm-test/test.md
4. ./doc_transformer index /tmp/perm-test --output /tmp/out
5. Returns "Found 0 files" with no indication of permission issues
6. chmod 755 /tmp/perm-test/test.md (cleanup)

## Expected Behavior
Warn the user that some files could not be read due to permissions.

## Fix Required
Add warning message when files cannot be read due to permissions.
